headline: Robust Disbursals Drive Performance Growth

highlights: Key Points  Repco Home Finance’s Q2FY27 NII / PAT was in line with our expectations, PPOP missed our estimate by 2.9%.
Net interest margin expanded by 10 bps QoQ to 5.5% as yield on assets stood at 12.0% and overall cost of funds held steady at 8.35%.
AUM growth accelerated to 9.2% YoY/2.7% QoQ, with total loan book reaching Rs 164.25 bn.

While interest spreads expanded sequentially to 3.7% (3.47% average), the management is selectively passing on rate benefits to retain high-quality borrowers and arrest balance transfer outflows, expecting spreads to stabilize at 3.20% to 3.25% over the near term.
valuation: Disbursement guidance remains strong at Rs 13.00 bn to Rs 13.50 bn for Q3FY27 and Rs 16.50 bn to Rs 17.00 bn for Q4FY27 (H2FY27 target of Rs 30.00 bn to Rs 30.50 bn).
The management re-confirmed its target to bring GNPA below 2.0% by fiscal year-end Borrowing costs remain well-supported by NHB refinancing facilities (Rs 6.00 bn sanctioned for FY27).
We thus maintain a ‘BUY’ rating on Repco Home Finance with a revised target price of Rs431 (valued at 0.55x Sep-28E ABV) as against Rs442 (valued at 0.60x June-28E ABV).
